# permio_group (Resource)

A group: a named set of principals in a project. Grants made to the group's `principal` (`group:<name>`) apply to every member. Groups cannot contain groups.

Manage members with `permio_group_members` (authoritative) or `permio_group_member` (one member each).

Groups cannot be renamed, because `group:<name>` is the principal ID their grants are stored under, so changing `name` replaces the group. Deleting a group also deletes its memberships and every grant made to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "permio_group" "engineering" {
  name        = "engineering"
  description = "Everyone in engineering"
}

# Grant to the group with its principal ("group:engineering").
output "engineering_principal" {
  value = permio_group.engineering.principal
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group slug: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Unique in the project. Changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the group, at most 1024 characters.
- `project` (String) Project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the object. API keys are scoped to one project, so this must be the key's project.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID assigned by Permio.
- `principal` (String) Principal ID to grant to: `group:<name>`. Use it as `permio_grant.principal`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A group can be imported by "<project>/<name>" or by "<name>" (the provider's project).
# Group names cannot contain "/", so the two forms cannot be confused.
terraform import permio_group.engineering default/engineering
```
